description:
The unsigned calldata to borrow `usdg` USDG against posted collateral: borrow(marketParams, usdg, 0, account, account), with the
        post-action HF / LTV and a `warning` when the resulting LTV is above 70% of LLTV. Refused with oracle_stale when the ShareRiskOracle
        is fail-closed (Blue cannot price the collateral), unhealthy when HF would drop below 1 (with the most you could add),
        insufficient_liquidity when the market lacks the USDG. You send it with the account's own owner key; this server never sends.
name: borrow_take_quote
